comments.author: @Oops-i-did
comments.text: Just got back from Singapore… It was 19.5 hours to get there and 17.5 to get back.  The MRT was clean and air conditioned. However, there is a lot of walking associated with it. If you are only there for a few days, I would suggest using the cabs to save time. The Marina Bay Sands is a very nice hotel that I would recommend, it had many unique features that should be enjoyed. Lavo can be skipped, but their breakfast buffet in the lobby was very, nice and consistent for our week long stay.  The room was well appointed with a very cool feature. At night, if you got up to go to the bathroom, when your foot touches the floor, path lights, guide you to the bathroom that was also dim lit.  And turned off when you got back in bed. ( provided you turned off room. It took a couple of nights to lean. lights from the bed wall when lying down. The gardens were spectacular and twice nightly show was awesome. On the bay side, there was a twice nightly water show too. Santosa island was not as you would hope, the sand was subpar, the tram cars stopped running very early on, while there were a ton of tourists still looking for a ride. I luckily noticed the discreet sign and saw that all cars headed to Beach Station were full.. Tip get on the car going away from Beach station!  And order a cab whenever you need one. This is not NYC.
